Episode 21: Oath of the Three Arrows
note: terms.json; exactly 36 characters. Shared by 3 occurrences.
Full form since 0.2.12 (caption box sized by text width, limit 288 px): family name and 'Residence' restored; 'Koriyama Castle' is the approved short form used by the other Koriyama captions. 213 px.

en:
Soon after Motonari's death,
Shogun Yoshiaki raised troops
against Nobunaga. Unable to bear
being Shogun in name only, he rose
up, but was swiftly crushed and
exiled to Wakae Castle in Kawachi.
The Muromachi shogunate fell in
all but name, and Yoshiaki took
to wandering the provinces to
topple Nobunaga and restore it.


Yamanaka Shikanosuke rested in
Tajima, awaiting a chance to rise,
while Terumoto, now Mouri head,
worked to build up the clan's
might further under a new order.
And so, several years passed.

note: Item-hand-over caption, sentence form as U03330 'Handed over the letter.'.
